settings.title: What is this for?
settings.content:
The MyoLift™ Precision Wand Kit is designed for users seeking to:

  • Achieve targeted microcurrent therapy on specific facial muscles.
  • Address delicate areas such as around the eyes, mouth, and nasolabial folds.
  • Perform treatments like lymphatic drainage and deep muscle stimulation with enhanced control.
  • Customize their facial toning routines with interchangeable applicator tips.7E Wellness

Suitable for both professional estheticians and at-home users aiming for salon-quality results.

settings.title: What is included?
settings.content:
• One (1) pair of Applicator Wand
  • One (1) pair of Cotton Tips
  • One (1) pair of T-Bar Tips
  • One (1) pair of Small Ball Tips
  • One (1) 2 oz bottle of Infused Conductive Solution
  • One (1) Compact Carrying Case

settings.title: How to use it?
settings.content:
Preparation:

  • Begin with a cleansed and dry face.

  • Apply the provided Infused Conductive Solution to the treatment area to ensure optimal conductivity.7E Wellness

Assembly:

  • Attach the desired applicator tips (Cotton, T-Bar, or Small Ball) to the Applicator Wands based on the treatment focus.7E Wellness

Application:

  • Connect the Applicator Wands to your MyoLift™ device.
  • Select the appropriate mode on your device (e.g., Educate, Erase, or Rejuv).
  • Gently glide or hold the applicator over the targeted areas, following the device's instructions for each mode.

Post-Treatment:

  • Remove any residual conductive solution from your face.
  • Clean the applicator tips and wands with a disinfectant wipe.
  • Store all components in the provided carrying case for safekeeping.7E Wellness+1Reddit+1

For optimal results, treatments can be performed 2–3 times per week, depending on individual skin needs.

settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.title1: Is this accessory compatible with all MyoLift™ devices?
settings.text1: Yes, all accessories are designed to be compatible with MyoLift™ Mini, QT, 600, MD, and TriWave devices unless otherwise specified.
settings.title2: How often should I use microcurrent treatments with these accessories?
settings.text2: For best results, we recommend using microcurrent treatments 2–3 times per week. However, usage may vary based on individual skin needs and professional guidance.
settings.title3: Do I need to use a conductive gel or solution with these accessories?
settings.text3: Yes, a conductive gel or solution is necessary to ensure proper microcurrent transmission. For cotton tip accessories, use a water-based solution like our RePlenish Spritzer or Infused Conductive Solution.
settings.text4: Metal applicator tips like the T-Bar and Small Ball tips are reusable and should be disinfected after each use. Cotton tips are disposable and should be replaced after each session for hygiene.
settings.title5: Can these accessories be used on sensitive skin?
settings.text5: Yes, our applicators are designed to be gentle and suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin. Always start with lower intensities and patch test conductive products if unsure.
settings.title6: How should I clean and store the accessories?
settings.text6: Wipe down metal tips and handles with a disinfectant or alcohol wipe after each use. Store all components in a clean, dry place or the included case to maintain hygiene and extend longevity.
